Dry cable runs through the sturdy bead chain electrode of the Spark Tester and is exposed to the selected test voltages. According to various applications and standards, PURETRONICS offers **LIVE SPARK**, **ACUTE SPARK**, and **DC SPARK TESTER**, which are generally installed after the cooling end in the extrusion line, inspection line, rewinding line, or coiling to detect faults (i.e., bare patches, pin holes, or shearing of electrical wire and cables). Extensively used for power cable, control cable, telecom cable, LAN cable, RF Cable, automotive wire, and building wire. Faults detected can be counted and data can be logged for future reference in order to increase the quality and maximise the efficiency. For easy understanding and fast decoding, data logging graphical representation is also available. For quality assurance, various standard electrodes are available such as IS, UL, and many more. A directly mounted interface display unit for simple operator control (such as display of instrument status, test voltage, and other parameters) is available. > **Image Description:** A process flow diagram illustrating a typical cable extrusion line. The sequence flows from left to right: Pay-Off (Input Drum) ➔ Preheater ➔ Extruder ➔ Cooling Trough ➔ **Spark Tester** (highlighted as a standalone scanning unit on the line) ➔ Output Capstan ➔ Tension Controller ➔ Windup Drum. --- ## 1. Live Spark > **Image Description:** A product photograph of the Live Spark Tester. It consists of a large, white rectangular control cabinet mounted on a black metal frame.
